title: PSX Character Library v1.6: Oathfall added
bodyHtml:
Oathfall is in the Library: 14 dark fantasy knights and undead warriors, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 20 packs and 279 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Oathfall has its own new archive, Dark Ages (215 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other eight archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 20 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.6.0:

  • Added Oathfall: 14 PSX Dark Fantasy Knights and Undead Warriors: Black knight, Templar, Executioner, Plague knight, Inquisitor, Oathbreaker, Fallen paladin, Sellsword, Grave warden, Withered soldier, Deserter, Hedge knight, War priest, The withered king.
  • New genre archive: Dark Ages. Every future dark ages pack joins it.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 20 packs and 279 characters.

Oathfall is also sold on the Ironvale page, together with Ironvale: https://csaf.itch.io/ironvale-psx-fantasy-adventurers

How we tested it: every file in the nine archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (3144 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 378 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: this pack is number 20. The first step was reached by pack 19 and is dated: the Library stays $19.99 until 7 December 2026, then it is $24.99 for new buyers, as its own post here says. The next step is $29.99 at 22 packs. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 22 live PSX pages, 8 of them sold, 29 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
